items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: I'd like to tell you when we went to Frisco to play on the bill with Anna Marie Alberghetti at Fairmount Hotel where we stayed for about two weeks.

ctx.x: All of them. By name I remember them. Such as Ray Samuels, Tom Patricola, he's a dancer. Then you got a woman who plays the piano called Frances White, she was a piano player. We had Frank and Mel Brittons' band. Had Henry Sampson's band -- we played with so many different people it ain't even funny when I think about it. I'd like to tell you when we went to Frisco to play on the bill with Anna Marie Alberghetti at Fairmount Hotel where we stayed for about two weeks.
